parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM instance.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the values of specific response parameters.

parameters.name: NeedDetailAttributes
parameters.description: Specifies whether additional information is required. Default value: **false**. If the value is **true**, the AccessStrategyNum and AddressPoolNum parameters are returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-instance --lang en --instance-id instance1 --need-detail-attributes false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeGtmInstance --region cn-hangzhou --NeedDetailAttributes false --InstanceId instance1 --Lang en
